notes.zh-CN: 停止改为两段式：第一次停止本轮回合，若仍在转圈再按一次立即强制结束会话。Bot 不再绑定默认目录，可以读写任意绝对路径（含会话起始目录之外），写入仍遵守当前审批模式。未手动选择模型时，Kimi 在 CLI 提供 K3.1 Pro 的情况下默认使用该模型。Antigravity 在后台任务进程结束且没有结果时会在短暂等待后继续。macOS 为 universal 开发签名，未公证。Windows 安装包未签名。Android APK 为调试签名。iOS IPA 为开发签名，仅供团队已注册设备安装。
notes.en: Stop is now two-step: the first press stops the current turn, and a second press force-ends the session if it keeps spinning. Bots no longer have a default folder and may read or edit any absolute path, including paths outside the session's starting directory; writes still follow the current approval mode. When no model is chosen, Kimi prefers K3.1 Pro if the CLI advertises it. Antigravity continues after a background task process ends without a result. The universal macOS app is development-signed and unnotarized. Windows installers are unsigned. The Android APK is debug-signed. The development-signed iOS IPA installs on registered team devices.
